target_customer: Car dealership groups, mainly in France
problem: Dealerships miss calls and lose leads and service bookings. Sandra AI sold AI agents that answer calls and messages and automate sales and aftersales workflows.
business_model: B2B SaaS for dealerships with custom pricing by size
product_category: AI voice and messaging agents for car dealerships

founders.name: Badr El Idrissi Mokdad
education: Ecole Polytechnique and HEC Paris, dual degree in Data Science for Business
founders.background_notes: About three years consulting on call-center work per YC page.

founders.name: Ismail Majjad
education: Ecole Polytechnique and HEC Paris, joint MS in Data Science

founders.name: Skandere Sahli
education: Ecole Polytechnique and MIT, Applied Mathematics and Computer Science

exit.reason: Not stated. Trade press reports it is preparing to end European operations and told dealer clients contracts cannot be served after February 2027.

competitors.name: Numa
competitors.what: Voice assistant and AI inbox answering dealership sales and service calls and texts

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice agents with DMS and CRM integrations were buildable with 2024 voice LLM stacks, but French-language telephony and dealership system integration add work.

defensibility.rationale: Voice agent features were copyable and a US competitor already had hundreds of dealerships; integrations with dealer systems gave limited lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitor Numa scaled to over 1,400 dealerships by late 2026 per its own materials; Sandra AI announced the end of European activity in November 2026.

market_need_then: Dealerships take many phone calls, and French dealer groups such as Autosphere deployed the product, per French business press. No independent measure of spend found.

branding.domain_note: Uses sandra-ai.com; sandra.ai appears in some press.

identity.mascot_or_character: Sandra, the named AI receptionist, alongside a second agent named Sam

branding.brand_signature: Named AI employee persona (Sandra and Sam)

brand_strength.rationale: A named persona is memorable, but no press about the brand itself was found and a competitor criticized the AI employee framing.

outcome_analysis: Sandra AI sold AI agents to French dealership groups after YC Fall 2024 and signed a network deal with Autosphere, per French press. In November 2026 trade press reported it would end European operations, with clients told service stops after February 2027. The cause is not public, so no failure factor is assigned.
notes: Directory status is Active; the shutdown is from one trade article dated 2026-11-04 (a second article from Auto-Infos returned 403 and was not read). The article says it is preparing to end European operations, so a US continuation is not ruled out. Funding: CB Insights lists a $0.5M convertible note on 2024-10-10, FundedIQ and VCBacked a $500K pre-seed in December 2024; aggregators only, unverified, not recorded as a round. The company site returned no readable content. Completeness pass: a 500K round is recorded from CB Insights (convertible note, 2024-10-10); VCBacked lists a Pre-Seed in December 2024 with Team Ignite Ventures and Yellow. Stage is other because sources disagree. Stork lists further backers (Kima Ventures, Rethink Ventures, Station F), not recorded.
